source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Providing care for clients across the spectrum of kidney disease, including CKD management, dialysis care, and transplant support","B":"A role limited mainly to hemodialysis unit settings, rather than spanning the broader continuum of kidney disease care","C":"Fairly little involvement in providing patient education as part of the nephrology nurse's overall role","D":"Mostly administrative scheduling tasks, with fairly little direct clinical involvement in the nurse's day-to-day work"}}
source_row.rationale: A nephrology nurse's role typically involves providing care for clients across the spectrum of kidney disease, including CKD management, dialysis care (hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis), and transplant support, spanning multiple care settings.
source_row.source_name: American Nephrology Nurses Association — Scope of Practice
